content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Indore Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-11-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) for a project-based research position funded by ANRF.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the Research Associate post under a specific research project focusing on advanced materials and battery technology.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IIT Indore Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Electrochemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Nanotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Research Associate post is 32 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 06 November 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 12 November 2026. Further details will be communicated to eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting a detailed softcopy of their CV along with all relevant documents in a single PDF file to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by the candidates for applying to this position as per the official notification details.
